newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on CBOT, commercials, locals.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on CBOT, commercials, locals.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on local and commercial selling and lower CBOT soy values.

"There was Japanese buying of the May at the close, Cargill sold 1,000 November and locals and commission houses sold," a trader said. May WCE futures crush profit margin fell to -17.09 Monday from -14.37 Friday. July-Nov spread at $58.50, May-Nov $56, May-July $3, Sep-Nov $7.50. Volume was 6,564 lots, or 131,280 lots, with 120 hedges.
Japan bought 3,000-4,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
May canola fell $4 to $420.50, July lost $2.70 to $424.30. May flax lost $2 to $358.20, November fell $2.90 to $324.10.
May barley lost $1.80 to $140.70 on light commercial and commission trade. Volume was 550 lots. Oats did not trade.
May feed wheat fell $1.20 to $170.80, and July fell $1.30 to $167 as Louis Dreyfus bought from locals and commercials, traders said. May-July spread at $3, July-Mar $2.
RBC-DS sold 15 May feed pea contracts to UGG up US$3.70 to US$214.20.
(All values in Canadian dollars, except feed peas)
